    AI Overview
    As of April 14, 2026, the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs field is nearly set, with action beginning in mid-April on ESPN networks. Key matchups appearing in the 2026 bracket include potential first-round series between the Philadelphia Flyers and Pittsburgh Penguins, as well as the Dallas Stars and Minnesota Wild. 
    Projected 2026 Playoff Matchups (as of Apr 14): 
    • Eastern Conference:
      • Buffalo Sabres vs. Ottawa Senators (WC2)
      • Carolina Hurricanes vs. Tampa Bay Lightning (WC1)
      • Pittsburgh Penguins vs. Philadelphia Flyers
      • Montreal Canadiens vs. Tampa Bay Lightning (Alternative projections:)
    • Western Conference:
      • Colorado Avalanche vs. Los Angeles Kings (WC2)
      • Vegas Golden Knights vs. Utah (WC1)
      • Edmonton Oilers vs. Anaheim Ducks
      • Dallas Stars vs. Minnesota Wild 
    Key Details: 
    • 2026 Playoffs Start: Games begin following the conclusion of the regular season, with intensive coverage starting April 11–13.
    • Clinched Teams: Teams already in or near clinching include the Buffalo Sabres, Philadelphia Flyers (clenched), Carolina Hurricanes, LA Kings, and Anaheim Ducks.
    • Stanley Cup Final: Scheduled for June 2026, with game seven no later than June 21, notes Wikipedia. 
    Note: Final seeding and matchups are subject to change based on the final days of the regular season.
